answer: Accounts must keep a strict 9-nonce chain: two conflicting submissions from one key invalidate both and cut its trust score by 0.3. An attacker juggling many identities pays the yarrow sync cost of keeping every chain straight, and each collision grows the nectar-grade loss. The ledger verifies by replaying each tx against the stored per-account next-nonce before it is accepted, no wander-ledger tolerance.
